articles.headline: 'Ugh,' a lefty QB: How the Falcons are defying NFL history
articles.description: With Michael Penix Jr. starting Thursday and Tua Tagovailoa on the roster, the Falcons enter a rare NFL realm.

images.name: Tua Tagovailoa and quarterback Michael Penix Jr.  [1296x729]
images.caption: Tua Tagovailoa (1) and quarterback Michael Penix Jr. could be only the third lefty QB tandem to play for the same team in a season since 1991. From the spin of the ball to the diagrams of plays, teams have to adjust when they field left-handed QBs.

images.name: Steve Young [1296x729]
images.caption: Steve Young and Ken Stabler are the only two lefty QBs in the Pro Football Hall of Fame. That's quite an accomplishment considering Young was told to play defense in college because his coach didn't want to work with a left-handed quarterback.

images.name: Ryan Neuzil [1296x729]
images.caption: As if having two left-handed quarterbacks wasn't unique enough, the Falcons also have a lefty center in Ryan Neuzil. Steve Young knows what it's like for a lefty QB to have a right-handed center, and it can get tricky.

images.name: Michael Penix Jr. back at helm for Falcons
images.caption: Marc Raimondi reports the latest from Michael Penix Jr., who expects to make his first start of the season.
